newsitem.title: USA: Agri-Nutrition Q4 net up on margin gains.
newsitem.headline: Agri-Nutrition Q4 net up on margin gains.

text.p: Agri-Nutrition Group Ltd said Tuesday higher margins for its branded pet care products helped fourth-quarter net income reach $26,000, compared to a loss of $127,000 one year ago.

Agri-Nutrition said it also completed its restructuring to an integrated operating company from an acquisition vehicle, a program that resulted in a one-time $240,000 charge in the period. The program is expected to reduce annual costs by $600,000, the company said.
Alec Poitevint will also assume the post of chairman February 1, succeeding W.M. Jones, who will remain on the board of directors, the company said.
Agri-Nutrition makes nutritional, health and grooming products for the pet and animal health industry.
